title: MV Timeline Evidence Self-Review
summary: Cross-reference verified frame times, lyric display intervals, actual audio measurements and observed visual action for bounded MV self-review when hearing is unsupported. Distinguish technical alignment from artistic judgment; keep unaffected work moving.

intents: Review MV image and music timing from existing assets
Diagnose editing decisions using lyric cues, waveform and actual frames
Continue bounded self-review when audio listening is unsupported
constraints: Use existing authorized media and tools; do not assume hearing or fabricate perceptual approval.
Requires verified timebase and source identity; cue timestamps are display ranges until independently verified.
Needs readable video/audio, timed text, a shot map or frame timestamps, and a permitted media analysis environment.

procedure.instruction: Freeze edit, audio and cue versions/hashes; record verified CFR or actual PTS, stream offsets, trim and frame numbering. Preserve original assets.
Identify cue provenance. Subtitle display ranges are not precise sung-word timing or new ASR. Mark feature type/settings and whether any actual hearing exists.
Convert zero-based half-open frame ranges to a common clock; use PTS for VFR. Compute all cue overlaps and signed event deltas, not just nearest labels.

Decode the real audio with fixed channel/sample settings. Measure waveform/RMS and structural candidates; reject negligible-signal normalized peaks. Flux is not a verified beat; subtitle gaps are not silence.

Inspect actual imagery and dense boundary frames. Record source version and observed setup, contact, result, reaction and release. Earlier contact sheets or sparse frames cannot certify current continuous motion.
Compare action phases and lyric meaning with intended expression, including deliberate counterpoint. Do not force every word/peak to a cut or remove meaningful held shots solely for stillness.

Report technical timing, visual structure, motion, dramatic intent and perceptual listening separately. Numerical alignment does not prove artistic success. Treat user feedback as evidence, not mandatory direction or final approval.

Choose retain, retime, visual repair or targeted listening check. If hearing is unsupported continue supported review; notify exact remaining question and only pause its dependent work, never silently the whole project.

Save sources, mapping, measurements, visual evidence versions, decisions, failed assumptions and limitations. After changes verify preserved audio/timing. Do not promote ACTIVE without actual repository-required terminal PASS evidence.
